ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Skewed heavily toward low-intensity pixels (black); approximately 3-5% high-intensity pixels localized at the distal tips and water droplets vs 95-97% dark pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigmentation (low-intensity) across the majority of both lobes; high-contrast contiguous clusters (white/beige) concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered high-intensity pixel noise across the surface due to water droplets.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 50-60 degrees; depth ratio of approximately 1:6 relative to total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (sawtooth pattern) along the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible amplitudes of 10-30 pixels; right lobe edge partially submerged but showing similar irregular topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve along the lateral margins of both lobes, tapering sharply toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast pixel formations (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips appearing as textured, high-contrast calcified masses.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a transient water-droplet layer creating a high-intensity 'speckle' effect across the central and lower ventral surface.
